parameters.text: Extract the KYC fields from the attached identity document image and return only the JSON object.

messageValues.message: You are a KYC document verification specialist at an Indian bank. You read identity documents (primarily PAN cards) and extract fields exactly as printed. Rules: (1) Never guess - if a field is unreadable, return an empty string and lower extraction_confidence. (2) Return dates as YYYY-MM-DD. (3) document_type is one of PAN_CARD, AADHAAR, PASSPORT, DRIVING_LICENCE, VOTER_ID, OTHER, NOT_A_DOCUMENT. (4) is_government_id is true only for a genuine-looking government-issued ID. (5) legibility and extraction_confidence are 0 to 1. (6) tampering_signals lists concrete visual red flags (mismatched fonts, edited text regions, screenshot of a screen, photocopy of a photocopy, missing hologram/emblem, inconsistent layout); return ["none"] if you see none. You are not told what the applicant typed, so extract independently.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "document_type": "PAN_CARD", "is_government_id": true, "name_on_document": "RAHUL KUMAR SHARMA", "father_name_on_document": "SURESH KUMAR SHARMA", "dob_on_document": "1994-07-21", "id_number": "ABCPS1234K", "legibility": 0.92, "tampering_signals": ["none"], "extraction_confidence": 0.9, "notes": "Clear image, all fields readable" }

messageValues.message: You are a senior KYC/AML analyst applying a risk-based approach in line with RBI Master Direction on KYC and FATF guidance. Using ONLY the evidence provided, produce: risk_level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH); ai_risk_score 0-100; recommended_action (APPROVE, REVIEW, REJECT); a concise, factual rationale an auditor could follow, citing the specific evidence; key_concerns as a list (["none"] if none); and customer_safe_message - a polite 1-2 sentence note to the applicant. Rules: Recommend APPROVE only when name, DOB and PAN all match, the document looks genuine and legible, there are no watchlist hits and no PEP declaration. Any watchlist hit, PEP, tampering signal or identity mismatch requires REVIEW or REJECT. Do not invent facts. IMPORTANT: customer_safe_message must NEVER mention sanctions, watchlists, PEP screening, fraud suspicion or internal risk scores (anti tipping-off); if documents are unclear just ask for a clearer upload.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "risk_level": "LOW", "ai_risk_score": 12, "recommended_action": "APPROVE", "rationale": "Document data matches the application on name, DOB and PAN; no watchlist hits; salaried profile consistent with declared income.", "key_concerns": ["none"], "customer_safe_message": "Your identity has been verified successfully." }

parameters.content:
## AI-assisted KYC Onboarding (POC)

**Goal:** cut manual KYC checks, onboard low-risk customers in seconds, and send only real exceptions to a human.

**Flow:** Form -> deterministic validation (PAN/age/email/mobile) -> Claude vision reads the PAN card blind -> cross-check form vs document + fuzzy watchlist screening with DOB as secondary identifier -> Claude risk analyst writes an auditable rationale -> code guardrails make the final routing decision -> every decision written to the `kyc_audit_log` data table.

**Guardrails:** AI never auto-rejects; any watchlist hit or PEP always goes to a human; customer emails never reveal screening (anti tipping-off).

**Before going live:** swap the DEMO watchlist for OpenSanctions/World-Check via HTTP Request, add DigiLocker/CKYC lookups, set the compliance inbox.

### 🧰 Built with
- **n8n Form Trigger** for intake, **Code nodes** for rules and guardrails
- **Claude Sonnet** as document reader (vision) and risk analyst
- **Gmail send-and-wait** for one-click human approval
- **n8n Data Table** (`kyc_audit_log`) as the audit trail

### 1. Intake & rules
Regex + age checks run **before any AI call**, so bad submissions cost nothing.
- PAN format AAAAA9999A, 4th letter P
- Age 18-100, valid email and mobile
- Only the last 4 Aadhaar digits are collected

### 2. AI document intelligence
Claude reads the PAN card **blind** - it never sees what the applicant typed.
- Extracts name, DOB and PAN number
- Scores legibility and extraction confidence
- Lists visual tampering signals

### 3. Screening, risk & guardrails
- Form vs document match: fuzzy name, exact DOB and PAN
- Fuzzy watchlist screening with DOB as the second identifier
- Rules score vs AI score: **the higher one wins**
- Code, not the LLM, makes the final routing call

### 🗂 Audit trail
Every system decision is written to the `kyc_audit_log` data table.

Human approvals and declines are logged too, so an auditor can replay any case end to end.

### 4. Routing, human-in-the-loop & audit
- **Auto-approve** - every check passes and final risk is below 30
- **Request info** - invalid input or an unreadable document; the applicant is told exactly what to fix
- **Manual review** - any watchlist hit, PEP or risk signal; a compliance officer gets Approve / Decline buttons by email (2-day timeout)
- Customer emails never mention screening (anti tipping-off)

### 🧪 Try it
Submit the form with a clear PAN card photo:
- Your own correct details -> **Auto-approve**
- Name `Imran Rashid Qureshi` -> demo watchlist hit -> **Manual review**
- A blurry or cropped photo -> **Request info**

### 📊 Risk score cheat-sheet
- Watchlist strong match **+60**, possible match **+35**
- Document unreadable or not a government ID **+40**
- PAN mismatch, PEP declared or tampering signals **+30** each
- Name or DOB mismatch **+25** each
- Input validation failed **+20**

**LOW** < 30 · **MEDIUM** 30-59 · **HIGH** 60+

### 🚀 Before going live
- Replace the DEMO watchlist with OpenSanctions / World-Check via an HTTP Request node
- Add DigiLocker / CKYC lookups for a second identity source
- Send review emails to a shared compliance inbox, not a personal one
- Attach an error workflow so failed runs raise an alert
